files.text:
CMOS tri-state driver with bus keeper
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VEN en 0 PWL(0 3.3 40n 3.3 40.1n 0 100n 0 100.1n 3.3 160n 3.3 160.1n 0 220n 0 220.1n 3.3 280n 3.3)
VD d 0 PWL(0 0 60n 0 60.1n 3.3 180n 3.3 180.1n 0 280n 0)
XDUT vdd 0 bus en d astra_028_cmos_tristate_bus_keeper
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec drive_low range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec hold_low range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec drive_high range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec hold_high range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec redrive_low range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 20p 280n
meas tran drive_low FIND v(bus) AT=30n
meas tran hold_low FIND v(bus) AT=85n
meas tran drive_high FIND v(bus) AT=130n
meas tran hold_high FIND v(bus) AT=200n
meas tran redrive_low FIND v(bus) AT=260n
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end

.model AD D(IS=2n N=1.8 RS=0.5 CJO=2p TT=4n)
